source: GET https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=<endpoint id> (public, no key), User-Agent schema-drift-check/1.0, one request at a time
ours: FAL_ENDPOINT_REQUEST_SCHEMAS in packages/provider/fal/src/zod.ts, through z.toJSONSchema (input mode)

classes.STRICTER: apicity rejects a request that fal accepts
classes.LOOSER: apicity accepts a request that fal rejects
classes.MISSING: fal lists an input field apicity does not model
classes.EXTRA: apicity models a field fal does not list
classes.GONE: fal serves no queue OpenAPI schema for an endpoint apicity ships
classes.UNMAPPED: a request schema this check cannot pair with a fal input schema
